name: library-management-system
description: Library Management System: React + TypeScript frontend, Node + Express + TypeScript backend, SQLite. Two-tier auth: API-level client-credential token + user-level email/password login.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.clean:api: rm -rf backend/node_modules backend/dist backend/data backend/coverage backend/*.tsbuildinfo
scripts.clean: npm run clean:api && npm run clean:web && npm run clean:root
